## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test --release`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` pass
- [ ] A user-facing change has a line in CHANGELOG.md under "Unreleased" (a breaking one with "before → after")
- [ ] A new public API has docs and an example scene, and follows CONTRIBUTING.md
